# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Document the model and serial number of the appliance being tested as well as the manufacturing date, and the purpose and location of the test.

2. Include the name and credentials of the tester.
3. Clearly note the date and time of the test to keep records precise and to detect any patterns of failure over time.

4. Specify the testing procedure.
   - Describe the test standards followed (such as IEC, IEEE, NEC), and reference any particular sections relevant to the test.
   - Detail the test equipment used, including make, model, and calibration date.

5. Record the inspection results.
   - Document any visual inspections conducted, including checks for damaged or frayed wires, signs of overheating, or other physical signs of wear.
